Define the missing constants CANDIDATE_COUNT, DONT_LOOK_LIMIT, and TIME_MARGIN at the start of solve() to fix the NameError and allow the program to run.

Fix the don't-look bits indexing bug (currently indexed by tour position `i` instead of city ID `a`) which was identified as a +0.023-0.032 score improvement in previous runs, and expose kick parameters for optimization.

Replace the full-tour 2-opt reoptimization after each kick with a localized 2-opt that only examines edges incident to the perturbed segment and their neighbors, dramatically reducing per-kick cost and allowing many more effective perturbations within the time limit.
